review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–232). It contains only theorems: one private helper, the coefficient lemma, a decomposition lemma, an iSup characterization, and two Lie-subalgebra equalities. It has no def, structure, class, abbrev or instance, so it adds no concept that could compete with one in Mathlib, Batteries or core. All the notions it uses come from other modules or Mathlib: Derivation.adjointWeightSpace, Derivation.cotangentLinearEquiv, the DirectSum.Decomposition API, LaurentPolynomial, AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeBialgEquiv, and Submodule iSup. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening, so I did not look for lemma-level overlaps. The repeated expression `(AddMonoidAlgebra.toMultiplicativeBialgEquiv R R ℤ).toBialgHom.comp l` is a verbosity issue, not a competing concept. I did not open the upstream TauCeti files that define the adjoint weight space API, so I did not check whether they duplicate Mathlib. Those files are outside this target.
